# spx_eip (Resource)

Manages an Elastic IP on SPX.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "spx_vpc" "example" {
  name = "my-vpc"
}

resource "spx_subnet" "example" {
  name        = "my-subnet"
  vpc_id      = spx_vpc.example.id
  protocol    = "IPv4"
  ipv4        = "10.11.12.0/24"
  nat_gateway = true
}

# EIP bound to a single internal IP (floating IP)
resource "spx_eip" "floating" {
  name        = "my-eip-floating"
  subnet_id   = spx_subnet.example.id
  internal_ip = "10.11.12.11"
}

# EIP shared by the subnet for outbound traffic (SNAT),
# forwarding inbound ports to an instance (DNAT)
resource "spx_eip" "nat" {
  name      = "my-eip-nat"
  subnet_id = spx_subnet.example.id
  snat      = [spx_subnet.example.ipv4]

  dnat {
    external_port = "80"
    internal_ip   = "10.11.12.10"
    internal_port = "80"
    protocol      = "tcp"
  }

  dnat {
    external_port = "2222"
    internal_ip   = "10.11.12.10"
    internal_port = "22"
    protocol      = "tcp"
  }
}

output "eip_nat_external_ip" {
  value = spx_eip.nat.external_ip
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the EIP.
- `subnet_id` (String) The ID of the subnet.

### Optional

- `az` (String) The availability zone of the EIP. If not set, the provider value is used.
- `dnat` (Block List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--dnat))
- `internal_ip` (String) The internal IP address.
- `orga_id` (String) The organization ID. If not set, the provider value is used.
- `project_id` (String) The project ID. If not set, the provider value is used.
- `snat` (List of String) The list of internal IPs for SNAT.

### Read-Only

- `external_ip` (String) The external IP address.
- `id` (String) The ID of the EIP.
- `nat` (String) The NAT type of the EIP (fip or snat).
